record_title: Talagrand operator-cotype counterexamples at every finite exponent
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result strengthens arXiv:2609.19731v1 from q=2 and Hadamard dimensions to every fixed finite q>=2, simultaneously on the same family, and to every sufficiently large dimension via a flat DCT matrix. It does not address q=infinity, does not claim the logarithmic exponent is optimal for q>2, and does not claim the interpolation lemma, DCT identities, subgaussian maximum estimate, or classical Gaussian-cotype bounds are new. Older operator-cotype literature may contain equivalent formulations under different terminology.
